text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquers the Arima Kinen. 
Yet, both she and Biwa Hayahide are still 
aiming for even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching from the stands, Symboli Rudolf 
felt a quiet thrill surge within her 
heart. Dreaming of the day she would race 
Narita Brian—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The defeated competitors shared the exact 
same desire to reach the top as Narita 
Brian. They will forever remain 
challengers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the Arima Kinen came to a close. 
Narita Brian will keep on running from 
here on out. Ever onward, in search of 
worthy rivals—
